reason: I've got years of bookings, customers and maintenance history sitting in the system I already pay for, and it does the job well enough. I'm not ripping that out for a brand new outfit with no customers just because it's in the cloud.
objection: Moving all my data and retraining the drivers and office mid-season, onto software nobody else is running yet. If it falls over on a Friday with three weddings and a school excursion booked, it's my name on the line, not theirs.
would_change_my_mind: If they migrated all my existing data across for free and I could talk to a few operators my size who'd been running it smoothly for six months or more.
